items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Ernest Rogers was playing, but not with known bands, you know.

ctx.x: What about Ernest Rogers? Was he playing?
Ernest Rogers was playing, but not with known bands, you know. He never was a big with none of the outstanding bands.

Yeah, he never became a singer. That's right, that's right, that's right. He was pretty young in those days, too, I guess. Yes, I guess, you know, Ernest was older than me, I think. In fact, all the fellas were young, we think of them as being older then, because in later years.
